text:
Ana L: Quick check — post-webinar asset handoff plan? We need captions, clips, and afterparty recording queued. Webinar tomorrow 10:00am PT.
Sam P: I can own Zoom recording split + captions. Which S3 bucket for raw mp4?
Ana L: s3://rw-marketing/webinars/inference-spring-2026/raw — I will create folder after wrap. Need captions asap for CLM email.
Jordan M: Zoom settings recs: cloud recording (single mp4 + auto-transcript), record active speaker. Auto-transcript not perfect; run a second pass.
Kevin R: Suggested Zoom settings:
```
/settings:
- cloud_recording: true
- record_separate_audio_files: false
- auto_transcription: true
- recording_layout: active_speaker
- enable_closed_captioning: true
- save_chat: true
```
Tess C: Copy that. I'll enable cloud record + save chat. Who owns edit + highlight clips?
Sam P: @Tess C I'll do the 0:10–2:00 social highlight edits. Need SRT from caption job — prefer Rev.com for quality but AWS Transcribe for speed.
Olivia S: Registration page checklist: add GDPR consent, 'Send replay' opt-in, hidden UTM fields, and confirm timezone conversions for APAC.
Olivia S: Reg form snippet I added:
```
<form id="reg">
  <input name="email" required />
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="inference-bench-spring-2026" />
  <label><input type="checkbox" name="replay_opt_in" /> Send replay</label>
</form>
```
Sam P: Post-event SLA timeline: 0-24h raw + auto SRT, 48h edited highlights, 72h full replay with CTA to demo + lead routing to Sales.
Ana L: Also planning an afterparty room — set co-hosts allowed, record audio-only for podcast snippets. Do we record locally or cloud?
Jordan M: Record afterparty cloud (keeps everything linked). Mark it audio-only layout for easier clipping.
zoom-bot: Recording scheduled: cloud recording enabled for meeting 2061122334. Recording link (post-stop): https://zoom.us/recording/abcdef123456
Kevin R: Once recording done, pipeline: caption job -> SRT -> burn-in version v1 -> clip export for socials. I'll drop a script for trimming.
Tess C: I'll route final assets to Marketing Drive and tag owners. Destination: /drive/Marketing/Webinars/Inference/Afterparty.
Ana L: Final preflight checklist: (1) Zoom cloud recording ON (2) co-hosts set: @Sam P @Tess C @Kevin R (3) reg page live + UTM tags (4) post-event SLAs set. @Olivia S can you confirm reg page live by EOD?
Olivia S: Confirmed — reg page live, link: https://redwood.ai/events/inference-benchmarks, privacy copy added and consent box enabled.
Sam P: I'll add captions workflow to the ops runbook and ping infra when recording completes. :thumbsup: 
Ana L: Perfect — moving to done once assets have landed. :rocket:
